=== THE TASK ===
Rebuild the place described above on the 200 m x 200 m plate, at the density
and arrangement the description calls for. Budget is 800 tool calls and 180
minutes; every tool result reports how much of both you have spent. Spend as
much or as little as the job needs, and decide for yourself when the scene
matches the description.

clauses.text: Scene:
identity: stylized cyberpunk city fragment at night
ground: uninterrupted flat pale-blue ground plane beneath floating city fragment
absent: roads, curbs, vegetation, terrain detail, continuous street network
sky: deep navy
Core:
shape: dense irregular cross-shaped cluster
buildings: roughly a dozen connected mid-rise blocks, tightly packed
spaces: narrow alleys, small open courts
façades: dark brick, gray stucco, muted red
projections: window bays, balconies, exterior stairs, awnings
building equipment: vents, air-conditioning units, railings
rooftop structures: sheds
windows: rows of small glowing windows
ground floors: compact storefronts, glass doors, illuminated display windows
ground floor signs: vertical or horizontal East Asian neon
Vehicle:
form: chunky red-orange futuristic vehicle
position: suspended above one courtyard beside open concrete frame
Outer towers:
count: roughly twenty detached high-rises
arrangement: much looser uneven ring around compact inner neighborhood
orientation: inward
spacing: broad empty blue gaps between towers and between the ring and the center
predominant form: simple rectangular residential slabs
windows: repetitive bands or grids, bright white-blue
heights: varied
rooftops: dark mechanical boxes
Landmarks:
quantity: several skyscrapers
glass towers: cyan-lit, capped with vivid hot-pink geometric crowns
pink edged tower: tall, wrapped in diagonal lattice braces and topped with antenna fins
dark slabs: a few extremely tall nearly black monoliths at outer edges
slab positions: some leaning into or cropping out of the view
Composition:
outer character: deliberately sparse and surreal outside the crowded inner core
boundaries: hard, isolated buildings and oversized dark slabs against sky
